content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the causes and effects of coronary heart disease
Describe risk factors for cardiovascular disease

refers to diseases of the heart and blood vessels. It is the leading cause of death worldwide. Understanding the causes and risk factors helps in prevention, while knowing about treatments can save lives.
The underlying process in most CVD:
Atherosclerosis is the build-up of fatty deposits (plaques) in artery walls.
From high blood pressure, smoking, etc.
Fibrous cap forms over fatty deposit
Reduced blood flow to heart muscle
Chest pain during exertion (reduced blood flow)
No blood to part of heart muscle
Severe chest pain (may radiate to arm, jaw)

CHD is atherosclerosis in coronary arteries

Risk factors: smoking, high cholesterol, high BP, obesity, inactivity
LDL cholesterol promotes atherosclerosis; HDL is protective
Treatments: lifestyle changes, statins, stents, bypass surgery
Prevention through healthy lifestyle is most effective
